sources.finding: Microsoft describes GDI redirection and DWM opening shared surfaces. This supports investigating the resource-to-composition boundary; it does not prove the cause of the local failure.
Microsoft documents cross-adapter GDI texture alignment and reserves certain surface types for system use.
OpenVINO documents NPU model caching and performance properties. Turbo can affect compilation, memory, latency and compatibility; it is not a proven remedy here.

An independent Lunar Lake reporter on NPU driver 5540 reports intermittent multi-model device loss. Later tests also fail with turbo, disabled idle-memory pruning, and keep-alive inference, weakening the initial idle-power hypothesis. Different hardware and models; no demonstrated equivalence to Delta.
Intel currently advertises NPU driver 32.0.100.5540, already installed on Delta.
